"First, enable permissions for Do Not Disturb or Modes access to allow the ringer to be silenced (you can do this within the app by clicking on "
Second, be sure to place a widget on your home screen. Once you\'ve done this, just tap the widget to change the ring mode. The widget will show which mode is active (normal, vibrate, or silent).
Controlling the ring state with calendar events

If you want your phone to enter modify the ring mode during events in your Google calendar, add either #RingControl# or #RC# to the event\'s title or description. To use vibration only, use #RingControl/V# or #RC/V#. To receive a notification when an event starts, use #RingControl/N# or #RC/N#. To change the mode earlier prior to an event, use #RingControl/+X# or #RC/+X# where "X" is the number of minutes (up to 15 minutes). Options can be combined. Options should be entered at least one hour prior to the event\'s start. The mode will change approximately one minute prior to the event\'s start (or by the amount specified in the "/+X" option), and revert back to the original setting after the event. Events must be less than 24 hours in length, and cannot be all-day.

Remember, the app needs access to the battery in the background. It also needs permission to read your calendar. Similarly, the app needs permission to send notifications if you choose to use that feature. If you did not initially grant these permissions, long press on the toggle to open the Settings menu and allow them.
